professionalSummary: Senior KYC analyst with experience reviewing individual and corporate onboarding files, including complex trust and holding company structures.
Quality‑checked new joiners, maintained error logs, and supported team training.
Managed escalation resolution with relationship managers and maintained weekly pipeline reporting.
Updated onboarding checklists following procedural revisions.
Demonstrated leadership through team management and process improvement.
experienceHighlights: Reviewed KYC files for individual and corporate clients, including trusts and layered ownership structures (src_5b3206d16a47).
Quality‑checked new joiners’ files, returned them with comments, and logged recurring errors for monthly refresher sessions (src_38ea293175f6).
Answered relationship‑manager escalations on stalled files, setting out outstanding documents and expected completion dates, and logged each escalation (src_9cba8e3b9797).
Updated the corporate‑client onboarding checklist after the 2023 procedure revision; changes approved by the onboarding team leader and compliance (src_2d6576400c5c).
Compiled the weekly pipeline report (files received, in review, awaiting documents, completed) for the team leader using the case‑management system’s daily extract (src_24909e965f23).
projectsAndWorkSamples: An anonymised quality‑check sheet for a corporate onboarding file, with comments on ownership‑structure documents and source‑of‑wealth narrative, and analyst responses (src_6679fa9ff9d2).
